Machine learning (ML) is a process in the field of artificial intelligence where a computer system uses statistical algorithms, often neural networks, to encode underlying patterns from data and be able to generalize to unseen data, thus being able to perform tasks without explicit programming or instructions.
Statistics and mathematical optimisation methods compose the foundations of machine learning. Data mining is a related field of study, focusing on exploratory data analysis (EDA) through unsupervised learning.
